#!/usr/bin/env bash
# new-mac：停掉本机 TG bot，不再抢 getUpdates；权威交回 old-mac。
# 保留 memory-git-sync（个人仓同步仍要跑）。
# 用法：bash ~/.dc-platform/memory/patches/tgbot-dm-cursor-agent-restore/release-bot-on-new-mac.sh
set -euo pipefail

DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
DISABLED="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac"
AUTH_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/AUTHORITY_HOST"
HOST_ENV="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host"
ROLE_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/tgbot-role"
mkdir -p "$DISABLED" "$HOME/.dc-platform/config" "$(dirname "$AUTH_FILE")"

BOT_LABELS=(
  com.youchu.automation-ensure
  com.dc.tgbot-daemon
  com.youchu.tgbot-dc
)

echo "=== 1) 停保活 + TG bot LaunchAgent ==="
for label in "${BOT_LABELS[@]}"; do
  launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$label" 2>/dev/null || true
  launchctl disable "$DOMAIN/$label" 2>/dev/null || true
  src="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/${label}.plist"
  if [[ -f "$src" ]]; then
    mv -f "$src" "$DISABLED/${label}.plist"
    echo "  moved $label"
  fi
done

echo "=== 2) 杀 bot 残留 ==="
pkill -f "tgbot-dc/runtime/bot.py" 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f "Application Support/tgbot-dc" 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f "omdb/tgbot/bot.py" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp/tgbot-dc.pid /tmp/tgbot-dc-daemon.pid /tmp/tgbot-dc.heartbeat 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1

echo "=== 3) 角色 auxiliary + 权威 old-mac ==="
printf 'auxiliary\n' >"$ROLE_FILE"
cat >"$AUTH_FILE" <<'EOF'
# 正式日报权威主机（一行，勿加引号）
# 2026-11-23：TG bot 交回 old-mac；new-mac 不起 bot（不抢 token）
old-mac
EOF
printf '%s\n' 'export WORKLOG_HOST_ID=old-mac' >"$HOST_ENV"

# 仅标记「本机不起自动化保活」；memory-git-sync 保持
cat >"$HOME/.dc-platform/config/DISABLE_LOCAL_AUTOMATION" <<'EOF'
# 本机（new-mac）不起 TG bot / 自动化保活，交由 old-mac。
# 删掉本文件并跑 enable-automation-as-authority-new-mac.sh 可再接管。
1
EOF

echo "=== 4) 自检 ==="
if pgrep -lf 'tgbot-dc/runtime/bot.py|omdb/tgbot/bot.py' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "  WARN bot 进程仍在" >&2
  pgrep -lf 'tgbot-dc/runtime/bot.py|omdb/tgbot/bot.py' || true
  exit 1
fi
echo "  role=$(tr -d ' \n' <"$ROLE_FILE")"
echo "  authority=$(grep -v '^#' "$AUTH_FILE" | head -1)"
echo "  OK new-mac 已停抢；请在 old-mac 跑 reclaim-bot-on-old-mac.sh"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# old-mac：应用私聊 cursor_agent 修复并重新拉起 TG bot（日常权威机）。
# 前置：new-mac 已跑 release-bot-on-new-mac.sh（否则会 409 抢 token）。
# 用法：

#   bash .../reclaim-bot-on-old-mac.sh --restart-only
set -euo pipefail

PATCH_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
RESTART_ONLY=0
[[ "${1:-}" == "--restart-only" ]] && RESTART_ONLY=1

DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
AUTH_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/AUTHORITY_HOST"
HOST_ENV="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host"
ROLE_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/tgbot-role"

echo "=== 0) 主机提示 ==="

  echo "MISS $CHCODE/omdb/tgbot" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== 1) 私聊模式 → cursor_agent ==="
bash "$PATCH_DIR/restore-dm-cursor-agent.sh"

if [[ "$RESTART_ONLY" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "=== 2) 权威 → old-mac + 角色 primary ==="
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$AUTH_FILE")" "$HOME/.dc-platform/config"
  cat >"$AUTH_FILE" <<'EOF'
# 正式日报权威主机（一行，勿加引号）
# 2026-11-23：TG bot / 自动化权威回到 old-mac
old-mac
EOF
  printf '%s\n' 'export WORKLOG_HOST_ID=old-mac' >"$HOST_ENV"
  printf 'primary\n' >"$ROLE_FILE"
  rm -f "$HOME/.dc-platform/config/DISABLE_LOCAL_AUTOMATION"

if [[ -x "$CHCODE/omdb/tgbot/deploy_app_support_runtime.sh" ]]; then
  bash "$CHCODE/omdb/tgbot/deploy_app_support_runtime.sh"
elif [[ -x "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tgbot-dc/scripts/start.sh" ]]; then
  bash "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tgbot-dc/scripts/start.sh"
else
  echo "MISS deploy/start；请手动起 bot" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== 4) agent-bus（若脚本在）==="
if [[ -x "$CHCODE/.cursor/scripts/sync-agent-bus-deploy.sh" ]]; then
  bash "$CHCODE/.cursor/scripts/sync-agent-bus-deploy.sh" || true
elif [[ -x "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/scripts/start-agent-bus-poller.sh" ]]; then
  bash "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/scripts/start-agent-bus-poller.sh" || true
  bash "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/scripts/start-agent-bus-cursor-executor.sh" || true
fi

echo "=== 5) 自检 ==="
sleep 5
if [[ -f /tmp/tgbot-dc.pid ]] && kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/tgbot-dc.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "  bot pid=$(cat /tmp/tgbot-dc.pid)"
else
  echo "  WARN 无 /tmp/tgbot-dc.pid，看 /tmp/tgbot-dc.log" >&2
fi
if [[ -f /tmp/tgbot-dc.log ]]; then
  if grep -q '409 Conflict' /tmp/tgbot-dc.log 2>/dev/null && \
     tail -30 /tmp/tgbot-dc.log | grep -q '409 Conflict'; then
    echo "  WARN 仍有 getUpdates 409：new-mac 或其他实例还在抢，先停对面 bot" >&2
  fi
  if tail -40 /tmp/tgbot-dc.log | grep -q 'Application started'; then
    echo "  OK Application started 可见"
  fi
fi
echo "  role=$(tr -d ' \n' <"$ROLE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
echo "  authority=$(grep -v '^#' "$AUTH_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo '?')"
echo "DONE old-mac reclaim"

# 经 memory-git 远程触发：仅 old-mac 一次性拉回 TG bot + 私聊 cursor_agent
# ENABLED=1 且 TARGET_HOST 匹配本机 WORKLOG_HOST_ID 时执行
# 成功后写 ~/.dc-platform/state/oneshot_reclaim_tgbot_oldmac.stamp，不重复跑
# FORCE=1 可再跑（或删 stamp）
ENABLED=1
TARGET_HOST=old-mac
FORCE=0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# memory-git pull 后：仅 old-mac 跑一次「私聊 cursor_agent + 拉回 TG bot」
# 不经 SSH；靠 stamp 幂等。new-mac 必须已停 bot（否则 409 抢 token）。
set -euo pipefail

MEM="${MEMORY_GIT_DIR:-$HOME/.dc-platform/memory}"
CFG="$MEM/config/oneshot_reclaim_tgbot_oldmac.env"
STATE_DIR="${HOME}/.dc-platform/state"
STAMP="$STATE_DIR/oneshot_reclaim_tgbot_oldmac.stamp"
LOG="$STATE_DIR/oneshot_reclaim_tgbot_oldmac.log"
PATCH="$MEM/patches/tgbot-dm-cursor-agent-restore"
RECLAIM="$PATCH/reclaim-bot-on-old-mac.sh"

mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
exec >>"$LOG" 2>&1
echo "==== $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') host=$(hostname -s) ===="

_host_id() {
  if [[ -f "$MEM/.env.host" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    source "$MEM/.env.host"
  fi
  echo "${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-$(hostname -s)}"
}

host="$(_host_id)"
ENABLED=0
TARGET_HOST=old-mac
FORCE=0
if [[ -f "$CFG" ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$CFG"
fi

if [[ "${ENABLED}" != "1" ]]; then
  echo "skip: ENABLED!=1"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "$host" != "$TARGET_HOST" ]]; then
  echo "skip: host=$host target=$TARGET_HOST"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ -f "$STAMP" && "${FORCE}" != "1" ]]; then
  echo "skip: stamp exists $STAMP"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ ! -x "$RECLAIM" && ! -f "$RECLAIM" ]]; then
  echo "fail: missing $RECLAIM"
  exit 1
fi
chmod +x "$PATCH"/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true

echo "reclaim on $host ..."
bash "$RECLAIM"

date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' >"$STAMP"
echo "OK reclaim stamp=$STAMP"

# 成功后关掉开关，避免以后 FORCE 误开时空转意图不清
if [[ -f "$CFG" ]]; then
  if grep -q '^ENABLED=' "$CFG"; then
    sed -i '' 's/^ENABLED=.*/ENABLED=0/' "$CFG"
  else
    echo 'ENABLED=0' >>"$CFG"
  fi
  echo "ok set ENABLED=0 in $CFG"
fi

day="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')"
wl="$MEM/work-log/hosts/${host}/${day}.md"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$wl")"
touch "$wl"
if ! grep -q 'reclaim-tgbot oneshot' "$wl" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "- $(date '+%H:%M') reclaim-tgbot oneshot: cursor_agent + bot 已拉回（stamp 已写）" >>"$wl"
fi
